policy: Authority Units are stable repository-owned heading-bounded units. IMPLEMENTED normative units have finite downstream bindings. FUTURE_UNIMPLEMENTED is a registry lifecycle, not proof of actual nonimplementation. Document-only technical revisions require a separately reviewed approvedUnimplementedRevision in the base registry for each changed normative unit, binding the exact old/new document blobs, empty registered and declared downstream, and reviewed impact assessment. Real downstream topology must land separately. Version/date front-matter metadata is the only NO_DOWNSTREAM_IMPACT maintenance class.
